descriptions.after: Where the activity feed reads on: the cursor its previous page answered.
descriptions.agent_answer: An answer to the named bundle as written.
descriptions.agent_session: An agent session: a Task listing shows the Tasks it submitted, 50 to a page, and a goal listing the goals whose record names it.
descriptions.analysis_answer: The Analyst's answer to an Evidence packet.
descriptions.analysis_context_hash: The Evidence packet's context an analysis answers, by its hash.
descriptions.analysis_publication_hash: A published Evidence analysis, by its hash.
descriptions.automation_enabled: true lets the daily research update run by itself; false stops it.
descriptions.automation_package_ids: The strategy packages the automatic research update covers.
descriptions.backup_generations_kept: How many backup generations to keep: seven unless a request keeps another count.
descriptions.bundle_directory: Where the agent's bundle is written, and its answer read back.
descriptions.calibration_plan_hash: A calibration plan, by the hash its PLAN answered.
descriptions.candidate_hash: The frozen candidate to finalize, by its hash.
descriptions.candidate_id: The Alpha candidate a Portfolio draft is built from.
descriptions.change_reason: Why the goal changes, kept in its record beside the change.
descriptions.citation_entity_id: The entity whose citation to open.
descriptions.citation_page: Which page of the cited source to read, from 1.
descriptions.citation_unit_id: The Evidence unit the citation belongs to.
descriptions.committee_key: That member's key: a specialist's is in its bundle, the PM's in its own open's answer.
descriptions.committee_message: One committee message, as its YAML or JSON file.
descriptions.committee_role: The committee member this request speaks or reads for: the PM (the lead), ALPHA, RISK or CRO.
descriptions.committee_seen: The last floor message the reader has seen, by its number (M4 is 4).
descriptions.component_id: The strategy component, by its id.
descriptions.continuation_of: The prepared packet a continuation reads on from, by the receipt it sealed.
descriptions.continuation_spans: The packet's sealed span set, by its hash.
descriptions.cpu_budget: `auto`, or a whole number of cores a book's preparation may use.
descriptions.curation_receipt_hash: The Factor curation decision, by its receipt hash.
descriptions.data_issue_case_token: The data issue, by the case token the issue list gave.
descriptions.data_issue_evidence_hash: The evidence the issue was shown with; an issue that moved is refused.
descriptions.data_issue_grant_hash: A person's recorded grant for a data decision, by its hash.
descriptions.data_issue_option_hash: The chosen option's hash as offered; a changed option is refused.
descriptions.data_issue_option_id: The option chosen for the data issue, one of those it offered.
descriptions.delivery_budget_bytes: The most bytes one delivered part may hold.
descriptions.delivery_commentary: The researcher's comments a delivery carries, each on the part it names.
descriptions.delivery_part: Which part of an answer delivered in parts to read, from 1.
descriptions.delivery_question: The research question a delivery answers, in the researcher's words.
descriptions.documents_page: Which page of the workspace's retained documents to read, from 1.
descriptions.event: The event this client declares about its own work (`ExternalActivityEventDocument`).
descriptions.evidence_as_of: The time Evidence is prepared as of, in ISO 8601.
descriptions.evidence_detail: Which detail of the packet to read: `litigation_inventory`, `session_windows`, `topic_coverage` or `time_view`; `EVIDENCE_CRO` also takes `time_view` for the published reading.
descriptions.evidence_documents_per_issuer: The SEC filings official acquisition may take per issuer; the default budget is three.
descriptions.evidence_index_id: The Evidence retrieval index to rebuild, by the id the storage view listed.
descriptions.evidence_setup: The Evidence setup's options, as its script takes them, for the running Host to install (`--acquire-sec --entities AAPL --network-consent --install`).
descriptions.evidence_total_bytes: The bytes official acquisition may read in all; the default budget's when absent.
descriptions.evidence_total_documents: The SEC filings official acquisition may take in all; the default budget's when absent.
descriptions.evidence_unit_id: One Evidence unit, by its id (u01, u02 ...).
descriptions.expected_task_hash: The Task's version as last read; a Task that moved since refuses the request.
descriptions.experiment_curation: The Factor curation decision: which factors go on, and why.
descriptions.experiment_document: The study's declaration as a document, as `study controls` or `study draft` writes it.
descriptions.experiment_kind: The study kind whose controls to show, as `study controls` lists them; Factor when omitted.
descriptions.experiment_plan_hash: A saved plan, by the hash its PLAN answered.
descriptions.experiment_receipt_hash: The Portfolio study's result, by its receipt hash.
descriptions.experiment_task_id: The Portfolio study Task a book comes from.
descriptions.experiment_yaml: The study's declaration as YAML text; send it or `experiment_document`, not both.
descriptions.extensions_page: Which page of the declared formula factors to read, from 1.
descriptions.factor_task_id: The Factor study an Alpha or Foundation plan builds on, by its Task.
descriptions.feature_document: A Feature definition as a document, for the Feature catalog to plan.
descriptions.feature_factor_id: A formula factor a research plan declares, which its review and activation name.
descriptions.feature_output: What a Feature build writes: `RAW_VALUES`, or `PREPROCESSED_VALUES` after the catalog's preprocessing.
descriptions.feature_plan_hash: A Feature catalog plan, by the hash its PLAN answered.
descriptions.feature_preparation_hash: The prepared Feature input whose controls a study reads, by its hash.
descriptions.feature_trial_id: A feature trial, by the ID its request answered with.
descriptions.finding_handle: A CRO finding, by its handle (FIND-...).
descriptions.formation_session: The session the scores are formed on, as YYYY-MM-DD.
descriptions.foundation_admission_hash: The Foundation, by its admission hash.
descriptions.goal_declaration: The goal as written: its statement, scope and completion rule (`goal schema`).
descriptions.goal_hash: The goal's version as last read; a goal that moved since refuses the change.
descriptions.goal_id: The goal, by the id its GOAL_OPEN answered with.
descriptions.goal_reference: What to attach to the goal: a Task, a study, a result or a publication, by reference.
descriptions.goal_reference_id: The reference ID saved in the exact goal revision; only that reference is verified.
descriptions.goal_statement: A note for the goal's record, written by the agent working for it.
descriptions.goal_submission: The completion document claiming the goal is met, naming its evidence.
descriptions.handoff_hash: The research handoff a book comes from.
descriptions.history_cursor: Where a list reads on: the `next_cursor` its previous page answered.
descriptions.history_entry_id: One research history entry, by the id the history listed.
descriptions.history_kind: Only the history entries of this kind.
descriptions.history_limit: How many entries one page reads, 1 to 50.
descriptions.incident_key: The Guanyin incident, by the key TASK_INCIDENTS listed.
descriptions.input_binding_hash: The research input's version, by its binding hash; with `research_input_id` it names the data a study reads.
descriptions.input_pinned: true keeps the research input's version from clean-up; false lets clean-up release it.
descriptions.ledger_page: Which page of the Evidence ledger to read, from 1.
descriptions.left_candidate_id: The first of two Alpha candidates to compare.
descriptions.left_result_hash: The first of two Portfolio results to compare.
descriptions.left_task_id: The first of two studies to compare, by its Task.
descriptions.limit: The most a page reads: 1 to 200 rows of the activity feed, 1 to 50 recent groups.
descriptions.model_id: An Alpha model, by the id its declaration names (`model list` lists them).
descriptions.model_lifecycle: A component's model lifecycle: `LIGHT`, the default, or `FULL` by name.
descriptions.network_enabled: true lets this workspace reach the network; false keeps it offline.
descriptions.observed_through: The last session the update observes, as YYYY-MM-DD.
descriptions.operation: The operation asked for; `alphalattice schema show <name>` lists its fields.
descriptions.origin_task_id: The study a new plan continues from, by its Task.
descriptions.performance: `latest` reads this exact book's latest retained Forward composite; omitted reads its saved report.
descriptions.person_confirmation: The person's yes to this decision, asked in one line and relayed whole: `--person-said` their words and `--asked` your question, which the client binds to this request.
descriptions.portfolio_scope: `holdings` reads only this saved date's positions, without its Forward report.
descriptions.portfolio_session: The session a dated view reads, as YYYY-MM-DD; for a book, names the book with the other book fields, as a book's offered requests fill them.
descriptions.position_basis: The positions a book's update published them on.
descriptions.preparation_binding_hash: The Evidence preparation's binding, by its hash.
descriptions.preparation_plan_hash: The workspace preparation plan to confirm, by the hash its PLAN answered.
descriptions.prepared_input_hash: The prepared input a Portfolio update reads, by its hash.
descriptions.prior_review_publication_hash: An earlier CRO review the export compares with.
descriptions.recovery_task_hash: The exact stopped Task version named by `recovery_task_id`.
descriptions.recovery_task_id: The stopped Task whose owner replan this existing planner/admission continues.
descriptions.remedy: The remedy to perform, one the incident offers: `CANCEL`, `RECOVER` or `REPLAN`.
descriptions.research_input_id: The research input, by its id (RESEARCH_INPUTS lists them).
descriptions.research_input_plan_hash: The research input plan to confirm, by the hash its PLAN answered.
descriptions.result_hash: A Portfolio result, by its hash; for a book, names the book with the other book fields, as a book's offered requests fill them.
descriptions.review_answer: The schema is the answer's, so capabilities describe it; an answer the schema would refuse is still carried, as written, for the Host to name each problem by item.
descriptions.review_dossier_hash: The CRO dossier a review answers, by its hash.
descriptions.review_policy_hash: The review policy the CRO answers under, as the dossier named it.
descriptions.review_publication_hash: A published CRO review, by its hash.
descriptions.review_read_at: When the review's dossier was read, as its bundle or first part sealed it.
descriptions.review_schema_hash: The review answer's schema, as the dossier named it.
descriptions.right_candidate_id: The second of two Alpha candidates to compare.
descriptions.right_result_hash: The second of two Portfolio results to compare.
descriptions.right_task_id: The second of two studies to compare, by its Task.
descriptions.risk_report_hash: A Risk report, by its hash, to export or deliver.
descriptions.risk_report_scope: `POST_OBSERVED_PORTFOLIO_WINDOW` links the Risk report over the Portfolio's observed window.
descriptions.risk_task_id: The Risk study to link, by its Task.
descriptions.score_plan_hash: A score plan, by the hash its PLAN answered.
descriptions.score_snapshot_hash: The scores a calibration reads, by their snapshot hash.
descriptions.session_limit: The most reading sessions the continued chain may hold.
descriptions.spec: The Portfolio book's controls (`strategy-book controls` lists them); those left out keep their defaults.
descriptions.storage_cap_bytes: `auto`, or a positive whole byte cap for managed writes; changes no result identity.
descriptions.storage_plan_hash: The storage clean-up plan to confirm, by the hash its PLAN answered.
descriptions.strategy_package_id: The installed strategy package, by its id.
descriptions.tasks_running: `auto`, or how many Tasks that may run beside others run at once, within the budget.
descriptions.tasks_waiting: `auto`, or how many Tasks may wait behind the running one.
descriptions.update_plan_hash: An update plan, by the hash its PLAN answered.
descriptions.update_publication_hash: The Portfolio update's publication a book comes from.
descriptions.update_task_id: The Portfolio update Task a book comes from.
descriptions.upgrade_set_hash: The installed identity set an upgrade overview showed, when acknowledging it.
descriptions.usage_reading_enabled: true lets the Host read the bound agent Sessions' own files for usage; false reads nothing.
descriptions.view_from: The first day read, as YYYY-MM-DD.
descriptions.view_last_days: Only the last this many days.
descriptions.view_to: The last day read, as YYYY-MM-DD.
descriptions.wait_seconds: How long a Task's status may wait for the Task to move on; at most 20 seconds.
descriptions.wake_codex_path: The client's Codex executable; the Host validates it or uses its PATH.
descriptions.wake_read: The exact read or rerun command, with its next free output path.
descriptions.watch: Tasks, by id, whose current projection the activity page joins; a short id the compact display gave reads as its whole id.
descriptions.window_limit: The most windows the continued chain may read.

purposes.ACTIVITY_LIST: Reads one page of the activity feed, with the state of any watched Tasks.
purposes.ACTIVITY_RECENT: Lists the newest requests grouped by agent session and goal, each with its read.
purposes.ACTIVITY_REFUSALS: Counts refusals over the last days (30 by default), most frequent first.
purposes.AGENT_ANSWER_SUBMIT: Submits an agent's answer to its bundle; the Host accepts it or names each problem.
purposes.AGENT_BUNDLE_PREPARE: Writes a specialist's complete bundle into a new directory; names its answer file.
purposes.CANCEL: Requests cancellation of a Task, optionally against the Task version you read.
purposes.COMMITTEE_OPEN: Opens the investment committee on a date's published positions, or reads the one open; writes each member's bundle into a new directory with its commands.
purposes.COMMITTEE_READ: Shows the committee's floor: its stage, members, tension points and the messages a member has not seen.
purposes.COMMITTEE_SUBMIT: Sends one member's message to the committee's floor, checked by its rules.
purposes.COMPARE: Compares two saved installed-strategy results: which controls differ and how metrics compare; no winner.
purposes.CONTROLS: Lists the controls of an installed strategy's Portfolio book, with defaults and limits.
purposes.CPU_BUDGET_SET: Sets the CPU budget (auto or a core count) or how many Tasks may wait.
purposes.CPU_BUDGET_SHOW: Shows the CPU budget, the machine's load and how many Tasks may wait.
purposes.CRO_REVIEW: Requests a CRO review of a book; the product runs no model, so use `bundle prepare`.
purposes.CRO_REVIEW_DOSSIER: Delivers a book's CRO dossier and answer contract, in parts when it is large.
purposes.CRO_REVIEW_FINDING: Delivers one CRO finding with its verified cited evidence.
purposes.CRO_REVIEW_SUBMIT: Submits a CRO's answer to its dossier; accepted risks publish as a Task.
purposes.DATA_CHANGE_CONFIRM: Approves a proposed data change by plan hash, admitting its Task; `run` then applies it.
purposes.DATA_ISSUES: Lists data issues with their evidence, options, decisions and grants, a page at a time.
purposes.DATA_ISSUE_CONFIRM: Records a data issue's chosen option; from the CLI only under a person's grant.
purposes.DATA_ISSUE_DELEGATE: Grants automation the right to confirm one option for a preparation blocked on data review.
purposes.DATA_ISSUE_PREVIEW: Previews one data-issue option's consequences; nothing is applied.
purposes.DATA_ISSUE_REVOKE: Revokes a data-issue grant by its hash.
purposes.DATA_UPDATE_PLAN: Plans a data update: due source checks, Data and Feature upkeep, any membership change; fetches nothing.
purposes.DATA_UPDATE_READBACK: Shows the workspace's data state and the latest data update Task, or the one named.
purposes.DATA_UPDATE_RUN: Runs a planned data update as a Task, within the workspace's network access.
purposes.EVENT_DECLARE: Records an event this client declares about its own work in the activity feed.
purposes.EVIDENCE_ANALYSIS_SUBMIT: Submits an Analyst's answer to a prepared packet; accepted findings publish as a Task.
purposes.EVIDENCE_CONSENT: Shows the consent to official SEC acquisition and the budget it admits.
purposes.EVIDENCE_CONSENT_SET: Sets the consent to official SEC acquisition: documents per issuer, in all, and bytes.
purposes.EVIDENCE_CONTINUE: Admits one more bounded source-reading session over a prepared packet, as a Task.
purposes.EVIDENCE_CRO: Shows a book's Evidence and CRO state, from preparation to published review.
purposes.EVIDENCE_CRO_EXPORT: Exports a published CRO review with its dossier and verified evidence spans.
purposes.EVIDENCE_DOCUMENTS: Lists the workspace's retained SEC documents, newest first, a page at a time; fetches nothing.
purposes.EVIDENCE_INSTALL: Installs an Evidence source package in the running Host as a Task: its environment, model, acquisition, index and publication; served at once.
purposes.EVIDENCE_LEDGER: Reads a book's issuer-topic reading ledger from its sealed packets, twenty groups a page.
purposes.EVIDENCE_PACKET: Delivers one prepared evidence packet for an Analyst, whole, in parts or as a chosen detail.
purposes.EVIDENCE_PREPARE: Prepares a book's evidence packets as a Task: acquires, reads and seals sources; no findings.
purposes.EVIDENCE_PREVIEW: Previews a book's evidence preparation: scope, sources and prerequisites; no Task or acquisition.
purposes.EVIDENCE_REFRESH: Requests an evidence refresh; the product runs no model, so use `bundle prepare`.
purposes.EVIDENCE_SELECT: Records which published analysis a book's review reads; refuses one that is not eligible.
purposes.EXPERIMENTS: Lists every study Task with its kind, input and declared choices.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_ALPHA_COMPARE: Compares two saved Alpha candidates from stored evidence; names no winner, recomputes nothing.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_COMPARE: Compares two completed Portfolio books on the same input and support; names no winner.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_CONTINUE: Continues a saved study by drafting, planning and running its next version in one request.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_CONTROLS: Shows the controls and an editable declaration for a new study on a research input.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_CURATE: Records a Factor study's curation decision: which factors go on, and why; no Task.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_CURATION: Shows a completed Factor study's curation choices and what a decision must name.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_DECLARATION_CONVERT: Converts a declaration between JSON and YAML; admits no plan or Task.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_DELIVERY_EXPORT: Exports one delivery report binding a selected book with its comparison, Risk link and review.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_DRAFT: Copies a completed study's declaration for editing, onto its own input or a chosen one.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_EXPORT: Exports a verified study as JSON, YAML and HTML with an export hash.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATIONS: Lists Foundation admissions with each current, historical or refused read.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_DRAFT: Drafts the Alpha declaration that builds on a sealed Foundation.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_EXPORT: Exports a sealed Foundation admission as JSON.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_PREVIEW: Previews the Foundation a curated Factor study would seal; nothing is sealed.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_READBACK: Shows one sealed Foundation by its admission hash, read from its recorded graph.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_SEAL: Seals the Foundation admission just previewed, named by its admission hash.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_SUMMARY: Reads one sealed admission's label metadata without verifying its source graph.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_HANDOFF_PREVIEW: Previews the Alpha declaration built on a curated Factor decision; nothing is planned or run.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_LINK_RISK: Attaches a completed Risk study's report to a Portfolio book as evidence; weights unchanged.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_PLAN: Plans a study from its declaration and keeps the plan for an hour; nothing runs.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_PORTFOLIO_DRAFT: Drafts a Portfolio book declaration from one candidate of a completed Alpha study.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_PREVIEW_READBACK: Shows a kept plan by its hash: available, expired, invalid or missing, and what follows.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_PROMOTE: Runs an explored study's declaration on its whole universe as a Task, or reuses it.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_READBACK: Shows a saved study verified against its sealed evidence, its standing first.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_REPLAY: Checks a saved study still matches the installed code and evidence; recomputes nothing, admits no Task.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_RISK_EXPORT: Exports one linked Risk report of a Portfolio book as HTML with its hash.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_RISK_LINKS: Lists the Risk reports linked to a Portfolio book, each with its export request.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_RUN: Runs a kept plan as a Task, or reuses the identical completed study.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_SUMMARY: Shows a completed Alpha study's recorded model, training facts and metrics, without re-verifying evidence.
purposes.EXPERIMENT_VERIFY_ALL: Verifies every saved study's sealed evidence in full, as a Task that yields to waiting work.
purposes.EXPORT: Returns the export manifest of a saved result; recomputes nothing.
purposes.FEATURE_ACTIVATE: Activates a reviewed formula factor into the workspace's daily feature catalog.
purposes.FEATURE_CATALOG_BUILD: Builds a planned feature's raw or preprocessed values as a Task.
purposes.FEATURE_CATALOG_BUILD_READBACK: Shows a feature build Task: its verified columns, counts and what they can feed.
purposes.FEATURE_CATALOG_CONTROLS: Shows the formula language, admitted recipes and an editable feature declaration for an input.
purposes.FEATURE_CATALOG_PLAN: Plans a feature change from its declaration and saves the plan; nothing is built.
purposes.FEATURE_CATALOG_READBACK: Shows a saved feature plan: its changes, work and next requests.
purposes.FEATURE_DEACTIVATE: Removes an activated formula factor from the workspace's daily feature catalog.
purposes.FEATURE_EXTENSIONS: Lists the formula factors the workspace's plans declare, with activation and latest trial.
purposes.FEATURE_REVIEW: Shows a formula factor's review packet: contract, trials, build coverage and activation.
purposes.FEATURE_TRIAL: Starts or reopens a trial: builds a planned feature, screens it, reruns a finished study.
purposes.FEATURE_TRIALS: Lists feature trials with their state and current step.
purposes.FEATURE_TRIAL_READBACK: Shows a feature trial's steps and, once complete, its comparison; changes nothing.
purposes.FINALIZATION: Shows a frozen candidate's release state and next permitted action; grants nothing.
purposes.FREEZE: Freezes a saved development result, by its hash, as a candidate for finalization.
purposes.GOAL_ABANDON: Closes an open goal as abandoned, recording why.
purposes.GOAL_ATTACH: Attaches an exact read to the goal as evidence under a stage.
purposes.GOAL_CONTINUE: Returns the draft that continues a study linked to the goal; plans and runs nothing.
purposes.GOAL_EXPORT: Exports a goal's verified record, with the book deliveries it names, as JSON, YAML or HTML.
purposes.GOAL_LIST: Lists goals newest first, a page at a time, or those of one agent session.
purposes.GOAL_NARRATIVE: Shows a goal's saved revision as recorded, without re-verifying its evidence.
purposes.GOAL_NOTE: Records a decision or conclusion in the goal's record; a conclusion must cite evidence.
purposes.GOAL_OPEN: Opens a goal from its declaration and binds this agent session to it.
purposes.GOAL_REFERENCE: Verifies one named reference of an exact saved goal revision at its owner.
purposes.GOAL_REVISE: Revises an open goal's declaration with a reason; a changed objective marks earlier evidence post hoc.
purposes.GOAL_SCHEMA: Prints the goal declaration, reference, note and submission schemas, with a starter declaration.
purposes.GOAL_SHOW: Shows a goal's latest or a chosen revision, re-verifying every reference at its owner.
purposes.GOAL_SUBMIT: Submits the completion document; the Host seals the goal complete or lists what is missing.
purposes.GOAL_TAKE: Binds this agent session to an open goal, so its requests are recorded under it.
purposes.MODEL_ACTIVATE: Activates a reviewed Alpha model for this workspace's research.
purposes.MODEL_DEACTIVATE: Removes an activated Alpha model from this workspace's catalog.
purposes.MODEL_EXTENSIONS: Lists installed and extension Alpha models, each with its review packet.
purposes.MODEL_TRAINING_INPUT_PLAN: Plans model inputs for a component on a research input; fitting and validation follow in the Alpha study.
purposes.MODEL_TRAINING_INPUT_PREPARE: Prepares planned model inputs as a Task, or reuses them; no model is fit or validated.
purposes.MODEL_TRAINING_INPUT_READBACK: Shows the model-input preparation Task, sources and support; fitting and validation are later Alpha study work.
purposes.NETWORK_ACCESS: Shows whether this workspace may reach the network and what decided it.
purposes.NETWORK_ACCESS_SET: Turns this workspace's network access on or off.
purposes.OPERATION_LIST: Lists every operation with its required and allowed fields, and the request schema.
purposes.PENDING_DECISIONS: Lists everything waiting on a person, each with the request that takes it.
purposes.PLAN: Previews an installed strategy's book from its controls: window, reuse and work; nothing runs.
purposes.PORTFOLIO_READBACK: Reads one exact book's saved report or latest Forward composite.
purposes.PORTFOLIO_UPDATE_PLAN: Plans a Portfolio update that settles observed sessions for an installed package; fits nothing.
purposes.PORTFOLIO_UPDATE_READBACK: Shows a Portfolio update Task, or a strategy's latest, with the book it published.
purposes.PORTFOLIO_UPDATE_RUN: Runs a planned Portfolio update as a Task, or reuses the identical published one.
purposes.RECOVER: Resumes a Task that needs recovery, or retries a blocked study whose artifact was repaired.
purposes.REPORT: Opens a saved result's report: window, book, controls and readouts; reruns nothing.
purposes.RESEARCH_HISTORY: Lists past studies, installed results, updates and CRO reviews, a page at a time.
purposes.RESEARCH_INPUTS: Lists each research input and its versions, naming any that cannot be read.
purposes.RESEARCH_INPUT_CONFIRM: Confirms a planned research input capture, which seals a new input version as a Task.
purposes.RESEARCH_INPUT_PLAN: Plans sealing a new version of a research input from the local sources; no network.
purposes.RESEARCH_INPUT_READBACK: Shows an input capture Task and the input version it published.
purposes.RESEARCH_STRATEGY_CONTROLS: Shows the strategy-preparation declaration schema and the completed Alpha and Risk studies it can use.
purposes.RESEARCH_STRATEGY_INSTALL: Installs a prepared strategy as non-default research in this workspace; the running service serves its packages at once.
purposes.RESEARCH_STRATEGY_PLAN: Plans a strategy preparation from promoted Alpha and Risk studies; nothing runs.
purposes.RESEARCH_STRATEGY_PREPARE: Prepares the planned strategy's Portfolio inputs from its Alpha and Risk studies, as a Task.
purposes.RESEARCH_STRATEGY_READBACK: Shows a strategy preparation Task, what it prepared and what is still missing.
purposes.RESEARCH_UPDATE_AUTOMATION_CONFIGURE: Turns the daily research update on or off for named packages.
purposes.RESEARCH_UPDATE_AUTOMATION_READBACK: Shows whether the daily research update is on, its packages and next due time.
purposes.RESEARCH_UPDATE_PLAN: Plans a research update bringing data, scores, calibration and the book to the latest completed session.
purposes.RESEARCH_UPDATE_READBACK: Shows a research update Task, or a strategy's latest, with the book it published.
purposes.RESEARCH_UPDATE_RUN: Runs a planned research update as one Task, or reuses the identical completed one.
purposes.RESULTS: Lists result metadata, for one Task when selected; opens no reports.
purposes.RUN: Runs an installed strategy's book from its controls, or reuses an identical saved result.
purposes.SESSION_USAGE_READ: Reads the usage of the agent Sessions bound to this workspace now, from their own files and the children they record; nothing else runs, and reading off reads nothing.
purposes.STATUS: Shows one Task's state, stages, timing and incident; may wait for it to move on.
purposes.STORAGE_CAP_SET: Sets the workspace storage cap to auto or a positive whole byte count; preserves retained work.
purposes.STORAGE_CAP_SHOW: Shows the operator storage cap, its automatic estimate and free disk.
purposes.STORAGE_CONFIRM: Applies a storage clean-up plan, deleting the input copies it names.
purposes.STORAGE_EVIDENCE_REBUILD: Rebuilds an evicted evidence index from its committed vectors, with a receipt.
purposes.STORAGE_PIN: Pins or unpins a research input or evidence index against storage clean-up.
purposes.STORAGE_PLAN: Plans a storage clean-up of unpinned input copies and saves it for confirmation.
purposes.STORAGE_READBACK: Shows storage use, retained inputs and evidence indexes, pins and pending clean-up.
purposes.STRATEGY_ACTIVATE: Runs a reviewed book's installed research strategy forward: the daily update scores, calibrates and gives its next positions; a person's.
purposes.STRATEGY_CALIBRATION_PLAN: Plans calibration of a package's Portfolio input from a published score snapshot; fits nothing.
purposes.STRATEGY_CALIBRATION_READBACK: Shows a calibration Task, or a strategy's latest, and the Portfolio input it published.
purposes.STRATEGY_CALIBRATION_RUN: Prepares a package's Portfolio input from a calibration plan as a Task, or reuses it.
purposes.STRATEGY_DEACTIVATE: Stops an installed research strategy running forward; its history stays readable; a person's.
purposes.STRATEGY_SCORE_PLAN: Plans scoring of a package's models for a formation session; nothing is scored yet.
purposes.STRATEGY_SCORE_READBACK: Shows a scoring Task, or a strategy's latest, and the score snapshot it published.
purposes.STRATEGY_SCORE_RUN: Runs a planned scoring as a Task, or reuses the identical published score.
purposes.TASKS: Lists the workspace's Tasks with their states, or one agent session's, a page at a time.
purposes.TASK_GUARDIAN: Reads every unfinished Task: liveness, stages, kept work, incidents and permitted recovery.
purposes.TASK_INCIDENTS: Lists the supervisor's incident records, open first, with what was done about each.
purposes.TASK_RECOVERY: Shows what stopped a Task, what stays verified and what recovery its owner permits.
purposes.TASK_REMEDIATE: Performs one remedy the Host offers for an open incident: cancel, recover or re-plan.
purposes.UPGRADE_ACKNOWLEDGE: Records the installed identities you saw on the upgrade overview, by their set hash.
purposes.UPGRADE_OVERVIEW: Shows what the installed upgrade changed: saved studies, reviews and waiting Tasks.
purposes.USAGE_READING: Shows whether the Host may read the bound agent Sessions' own files for usage, and what it reads.
purposes.USAGE_READING_SET: Turns reading the bound agent Sessions' usage on or off for this workspace.
purposes.WAKE_REGISTER: Asks the Host to queue one line to a Codex thread, naming the exact read, when the Task ends, needs a decision or is deferred; returns at once, the wake held in the Task's journal across turns and restarts.
purposes.WORKSPACE_BACKUP: Backs up what the workspace cannot rebuild, outside it, keeping the newest generations.
purposes.WORKSPACE_BACKUPS: Lists the kept backup generations and the backup root; makes none.
purposes.WORKSPACE_PREPARE_CONFIRM: Starts a planned workspace preparation: the CLI starts one under the workspace's first-use goal, or resumes one under a person's grant.
purposes.WORKSPACE_PREPARE_PLAN: Plans first-use workspace preparation, or recovery of a stopped one; acquires nothing.
purposes.WORKSPACE_PREPARE_READBACK: Shows the latest preparation Task, or the one named, and the inputs it published.
purposes.WORKSPACE_SHOW: Shows the workspace's inputs, recent studies and Tasks, data state, and next steps.
